title: What Judge Not Actually Means for a Godly Man's Own Life
caption:
Matthew 7 doesn't forbid judgment. It forbids grading your brother's speck before you've dealt with your own plank. Start with the mirror before you start with him.

You know exactly what you let slide when nobody's watching. That's where the discipline goes first, not on grading everyone else's walk with God.

Once your own plank is out, you can actually help him see his. Correction without self-correction first is just noise dressed up as concern.

Grade yourself hard and everyone else soft, and grace has room to work both ways. Flip it, and you'll drown in your own standard.

#faith #christianmen #manofgod #scripture #humility
theme: He's hard on himself, gentle with others.
